content:
This is too easy as a puzzle. Please re-create it as a clash of code.

Please also remember to format the line numbers in <<bold>>.

Thanks.

Constraints
* Please change 200 to 100.

* Please change 1 to 2.

* Please change 1000 to 10.

Game modes
* Could it be too difficult to infer the task from the visible cases alone in Reverse mode?

Cases
* Please add a pair of cases that satisfy all the following conditions:

  • N = 10

  • The journey includes both upward and downward movements.

  • A negative floor appears multiple times consecutively.

  • All other floors are randomly selected 2-digit floors.

  • The final floor is 0.

Thanks.
